title: Advancing early target discovery through large-scale proteomics and expansion plans for the UKB-PPP
description: Slides from an invited talk at the Festival of Genomics Boston, 25 June 2025, on using large-scale plasma proteomics from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) together with human genetics for early target discovery, and on plans for the next phase of UKB-PPP.
